name: confirm_live_identity
description: Unlock approved returning-user memory only after Amy has completed a useful warm exchange, received a real spoken name rather than User, Visitor, Guest, or Customer, and separately received explicit permission to check for notes from an earlier conversation. Use a clear name already supplied in response to the configured greeting; do not ask for it again. If no clear name was supplied, ask once what name to use. Never ask for or submit an email address for memory access; the application privately verifies the session-bound website check-in identity. After success, follow the returned instruction and prefer the newest approved notes over older superseded context.

preferredName.description: The real name the visitor stated in response to Amy's greeting or, only if that answer was missing or unclear, after one brief name clarification. Never submit User, Visitor, Guest, or Customer.

memoryAccessConfirmed.description: True only after the visitor explicitly agrees that Amy may check for approved notes from a previous conversation.
